notes: templ templates compile to *_templ.go, which are committed. If a .templ file changed, regenerate with `go run github.com/a-h/templ/cmd/templ@v0.3.1020 generate` before the check. NOT `go tool templ generate` — there is no tool directive in go.mod and no templ on PATH, so that form fails with `go: no such tool "templ"`.
